definition.title: Find the buyer words your site is missing
definition.description: Compare your site's messaging with repeated language from public customer reviews and return one evidence-backed message change to test.

site_url.title: Website
site_url.description: The public website whose messaging should be checked.

buyer_context.title: Target buyer
buyer_context.description: Who buys the product, what they are trying to accomplish, and what problem makes them look for it.

competitors.title: Competitors
competitors.description: Up to four competitor names or public URLs. Leave empty to discover obvious alternatives from search.

market.title: Market
market.description: Optional country, region, or language context for the review research.

focus.title: Specific question
focus.description: Optional message, objection, feature, or buyer moment to investigate.
